items.summary: Disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; counsel_required for rights-dependent data use and monetization. Official Woot API documentation establishes access mechanics only. Current public terms do not evidence permission to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Ordinary reversible internal evidence work may continue within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Do not send rights outreach until human counsel reviews the packet and the owner authorizes it.

Progress: official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts are identified. No task is closed because direct evidence remains incomplete for field rights, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: complete one dated readiness packet per site covering execution ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker.
